item.tib: tshogs lam mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las zab lam kun bzang dgongs pa'i spyod yul thig chen sngon 'gro rgyun khyer
item.coloph: ces pa'i zab lam theg pa chen po'i sngon 'gro kun bzang dgongs pa'i spyod yul bon nyid lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams pa bon spyod rgyun 'khyer 'di yang / lam lnga mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i cha rkyen/ zag med 'od skur grol ba'i dmar khrid/ shin tu zab pa'i nang nas yang zab/ dmar ba'i nang nas rin chen btso ma/ gces pa'i nang nas snying gi khrag thig gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i thugs dam 'di yang / tshe dbang mu la sgron gsal gyi snying bu tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am spral sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba des/ shar grol smin gling du dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'dis kyang zag bcas phung po rang sar grol nas/ zag med 'ja' lus 'od skur 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dza yan+tu//
